headline: DeepSeek tightens grip; five new models enter the fray
summary: DeepSeek's dominance deepened with a fresh v4-pro variant (rank 17, 1.3% share) joining the roster, while xAI's grok-4.6, Qwen's qwen3.6-35b, Google's gemini-3.5-flash, and Mistral's mistral-nemo all made their debuts. On the flip side, OpenAI's gpt-5-mini and Google's gemini-3.1-pro-preview dropped out of the top 51.
highlights: DeepSeek now commands 26.6% of tokens across three models in the top 10
Google surged 1.2% in daily share but remains down 3.7% week-over-week
OpenAI slipped 1.1% daily despite gpt-5.6-luna climbing 30 ranks in a month
Tencent's hy3 holds steady at rank 2 with 13.4% share, up 4.8% weekly
Five new entrants arrived; five older models exited the top 51
